description: 在乌尔德之泉旁参与制定命运秩序的三位诺恩之一。
fullDescription: 《女预言家之歌》第20节点名Urðr、Verðandi、Skuld，并描述她们立法、选择生命与安排命运。把Urðr简单等同于‘过去’是常见解释，但不应作为来源明确事实。卡图可以用刻痕、旧木与沉静水面形成‘已成之事’的视觉联想，但需明确这是艺术编码。
roleInSeries: 建立命运三人组的第一种视觉人格。

sourceRefs.note: 点名三位诺恩并描述其命运职能。

visualThesis: 沉静、稳固、贴近泉水与刻痕的诺恩形象；不是老巫婆，也不是抽象时间女神。

sourceBoundFacts: 与命运安排、立法、生命选择相连
interpretationNotes: Urðr=过去可作为视觉联想，但不是本节诗句的显式角色设定
年龄、服饰、发色均属设计
canon.worldState: 世界树与命运秩序已建立；场景集中于泉与树根。
mustKeep: 与另外两位共享材质体系但脸型不同
双手可与刻痕/木片/泉水互动

instructions: 三位诺恩必须不同脸型、年龄感、姿态和手部动作
Urðr最静态、最低重心；Verðandi更流动；Skuld更前视

visual.detailHierarchy: 脸、手、刻痕最高细节；背景泉水与树根低细节。
visual.subjectSeparation: 以静态清晰轮廓从柔和树根/泉水背景中分离。

prompt.draft: Create Urðr as one of the three Norns beside the world-tree spring. She must be a distinct individual, not an old witch stereotype and not a clone of Verðandi or Skuld. Use a grounded, still posture with subtle carved marks, old wood or quiet water as secondary motifs. The common interpretation of past/present/future is only visual inspiration, so do not add literal clocks, timelines or magical UI. Keep face and hands crop-safe in the upper-middle. Restrained mythic painterly style, natural materials, background softer than subject.
prompt.final:

Asset type: MythCanvas Norse M01 collectible-card source artwork.

Create ONE standalone portrait 9:16 pure artwork for card 1003010009, Urðr / 乌尔德, type character.

The image must contain no typography, title, logo, card frame, number, watermark, pseudo-runes, UI, collage, split layout, contact sheet, or panels.

Content brief: Create Urðr as one of the three Norns beside the world-tree spring. She must be a distinct individual, not an old witch stereotype and not a clone of Verðandi or Skuld. Use a grounded, still posture with subtle carved marks, old wood or quiet water as secondary motifs. The common interpretation of past/present/future is only visual inspiration, so do not add literal clocks, timelines or magical UI. Keep face and hands crop-safe in the upper-middle. Restrained mythic painterly style, natural materials, background softer than subject.

Visual thesis: 沉静、稳固、贴近泉水与刻痕的诺恩形象；不是老巫婆，也不是抽象时间女神。

Identity anchors: 沉稳；刻痕/旧木；泉水；独立脸型

Must keep: 与另外两位共享材质体系但脸型不同；双手可与刻痕/木片/泉水互动；不老巫婆化

Must avoid: 老巫婆；水晶球；塔罗占卜师；三女神同脸；科幻时间UI

Composition: camera eye level; shot seated or grounded three-quarter; keep the primary subject/action inside the crop-safe upper-middle area.

Match the established M01 artwork family: painterly mythic realism with matte surfaces, broad readable shapes, controlled cinematic blue-white frost and restrained ember light, atmospheric depth, limited focal sharpness, and restrained brush detail. Subject or key moment must be sharper and more contrasted than the background. Use mythology-first visual storytelling rather than generic AI fantasy. Keep at most one primary environmental motif and one secondary motif; preserve quiet areas and clear visual hierarchy. Compose for future card crop safety: the face, hands, identity symbol, key object, or story action must work in the upper-middle area; the bottom 30 percent may be sacrificed.

Color and material guidance: palette 深林绿；骨白；水灰；旧木褐; materials 泉水；树根；刻痕木；粗织物; mood grounded；fateful；quiet；ancient.

Related card IDs for narrative continuity only: 1003010010；1003010011. Preserve their mythic relationship without cloning faces, silhouettes, or poses.

Avoid these failure modes: old witch；crystal ball；tarot reader；clock imagery；magic UI；identical Norn face；glossy game-CG；typography; excessive particles, floating debris overload, glossy game-CG, hyper-detailed-everything, random glowing runes, generic Viking cosplay, modern copyrighted adaptation, malformed anatomy, extra limbs, unreadable hands or props.

Fill one complete portrait 9:16 canvas with no margins. Target final canvas at least 1620x2880 pixels.
